summary: _ansible_syslog_facility controls the syslog facility; use AnsibleModule.log normally, or read the facility name from _syslog_facility and getattr it from syslog.
questions: How do I log to the configured syslog facility from my module?
How do I set the syslog facility Ansible modules use?

answer_card.title: _ansible_syslog_facility
answer_card.answer_md:
Prefer `AnsibleModule.log`. If you must use syslog directly:
```python
import syslog
facility_name = module._syslog_facility
facility = getattr(syslog, facility_name, syslog.LOG_USER)
syslog.openlog(NAME, 0, facility)
```
Configure with `DEFAULT_SYSLOG_FACILITY`.
